Jessica: AM async — quick pipeline standup.

What I did: followed up with NovaHealth on Dedicated pilot EULA, uploaded KMS integration diagram.
Blockers: legal asks around BYOK key escrow from their risk team.
Today: pinging SecOps + solutions for HSM options, prepping demo for Friday 11am PT.

Noah: Got the exact risk ask — they want key-escrow proof & attestation examples. Can loop in Rachel from SecOps on a call tomorrow.
Also: QA saw higher latency with quantized model on dedicated nodes, opened infra ticket #4512.

Mike: CR review finished for dedicated-autoscaler PR, left a couple nits. Will merge after CI flake clears. Doing smoke tests for NovaHealth post-merge.

Olivia: Updated the Private deployment checklist (SSO/KMS) in docs; pinged partner to confirm EU region capacity for demo.

Rachel: SecOps here — we can provide an HSM on-prem flow but we need the customer's SOC2 and expected data retention. @Jessica send customer contact + expected throughput (tokens/min) so we can size appropriately.

SecOps: Note — our policy doesn't accept key escrow. Recommend BYOK with external KMS + audit logs. I'll draft an attestation template for legal.

deploy-bot: Deployed api-service v2.3.1 to staging at 3334440120 — rolling.

Noah: Follow-up from customer: target throughput 120k tokens/min at p95, wants an SLA. That's large — suggest dedicated pool + burst capacity and canary route for fallback.

Jessica: Ack. I'll propose Dedicated Tier-2 + canary route. Marking legal BYOK addendum as blocker until signed. @Rachel can you draft the attestation template? :pray:

Mike: Perf numbers added to PR comment:
```
seq_len=512: p95=180ms tok/s=700
seq_len=1024: p95=350ms tok/s=380
```

Olivia: 👍 I'll include these numbers in the demo slides.

Jessica: Thanks all — unless objections I'll set a 10am PT alignment call tomorrow and post invite. If anyone needs pre-reads, ping me here.
